summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (pinned to v1.3.13), extracts and chmods it executable in a temp directory, and then invokes it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript bundle using shifted string-array packing and a numeric-index decoder (obfuscator.io-style, `_0x`-prefixed and random identifiers), and its contents cannot be reconciled with the package's advertised purpose — the library's own `lib/index.js` merely exports the string 'John'. The loader `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with hex-named identifiers and per-function string-constant dictionaries, which is not consistent with legitimate native-addon install shims. The Bun runtime is used to execute the shipped obfuscated bundle outside the Node interpreter, evading Node-based install-time inspection. All of this fires automatically on `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle script.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
